kind: planned userdata flash and read-only chroot probe
limitations: Host fastboot supports raw import/resparse; actual phone sparse transfer must still be tested.
Guard verifies the exact previous user-built image; the binary is on the user's PC and not present here.
Writing userdata replaces its Android contents; stock DTBO restoration alone will no longer restore Android data layout.
Matching built DTBO must remain installed for the known debug kernel.
Mount/chroot is a userspace probe inside the debug kernel, not switch_root or systemd/HAL validation.
